found_on: MT5 CFDs (FX, metals XAU/XAG, indices, energy, BTC/ETH/SOL) 1h/4h/1d; threshold from returns before 2023-01-01

rule.zone: qualified origin (V=1): a 3/3 swing low/high, a close beyond the last known swing within 20 bars before trading through the origin, a 0.1+ ATR gap on the path, 2+ ATR displacement
rule.entry: resting limit at the near edge of the body band (origin low to body top for a bull zone)
rule.approach: close 5 bars before the return bar minus the return bar's low (bull; mirrored for bear), in ATR
rule.stop: 0.1 ATR past the far edge, at least 0.25 ATR from the entry
rule.target: 1R, net of the broker's spread floor; else out after 5 days

judged_once_on: the 32 validation crypto CFDs, XPT/XPD/XCU, and Deriv's Volatility 10/50/100, Step 200/500, Drift Switch 20/30 - none used in any zone study
passes_if: R a trade > 0 and above both the qualified zones without the approach rule and the unqualified swing origins with it, the day-bootstrap 90% interval of R excluding 0
status: VOID 2026-10-03: the approach feature read the return bar's own low, unknowable to a resting order; corrected, the effect is gone (origin-zones.md)
